text: In the official config.json files at the pinned revisions, google/gemma-4-E2B-it, -E4B-it, -26B-A4B-it and -31B-it declare architectures ['Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration'] and model_type 'gemma4', while google/gemma-4-12B-it declares ['Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration'] and model_type 'gemma4_unified'.
text_config.num_hidden_layers is 35 for gemma-4-E2B-it, 42 for E4B-it, 48 for 12B-it, 30 for 26B-A4B-it and 60 for 31B-it (pinned Hugging Face configs).

text_config.hidden_size / intermediate_size are 1536 / 6144 (E2B-it), 2560 / 10240 (E4B-it), 3840 / 15360 (12B-it), 2816 / 2112 (26B-A4B-it) and 5376 / 21504 (31B-it); num_attention_heads is 8, 8, 16, 16 and 32 (pinned Hugging Face configs).

text_config.num_key_value_heads is 1 (E2B-it), 2 (E4B-it), 8 (12B-it), 8 (26B-A4B-it) and 16 (31B-it); num_global_key_value_heads is unset (None) for E2B-it and E4B-it and 1, 2 and 4 for 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it (pinned Hugging Face configs).
Every pinned Gemma 4 text model config (E2B-it, E4B-it, 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it, 31B-it and both assistants) has text_config.head_dim 256 and global_head_dim 512.
text_config.sliding_window is 512 for gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it and 1024 for 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it (pinned Hugging Face configs).

In the pinned configs' text_config.layer_types, full_attention layers are at indices 4, 9, ..., 34 in E2B-it (7 of 35, one in five), 5, 11, ..., 41 in E4B-it (7 of 42), 5, 11, ..., 47 in 12B-it (8 of 48), 5, 11, ..., 29 in 26B-A4B-it (5 of 30) and 5, 11, ..., 59 in 31B-it (10 of 60); the last layer is full_attention in every one.

sources.publisher: Google DeepMind (model card on Hugging Face)
sources.quote: interleaves local sliding window attention with full global attention, ensuring the final layer is always global.

formula: indices of 'full_attention' in layer_types; count / total

text: text_config.attention_k_eq_v is false for gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it and true for 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it, 31B-it and both pinned assistants; the Gemma 4 technical report describes re-using keys as values in global attention layers 'except in E2B and E4B'.

sources.quote: We improve memory efficiency by re-using keys as values in the global attention layers (except in E2B and E4B)

text: text_config.num_kv_shared_layers is 20 for gemma-4-E2B-it (35 layers, so 15 keep their own KV cache), 18 for E4B-it (42 layers, 24 own caches) and 0 for 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it; the technical report gives KV sharing ratios of 20/35 and 18/42 for E2B and E4B.

sources.quote: Finally, we share the KV cache with ratios of 20/35 and 18/42 for the E2B and E4B model.

formula: layers with own KV = num_hidden_layers - num_kv_shared_layers: 35-20 = 15, 42-18 = 24

text: gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it set text_config.hidden_size_per_layer_input 256 and vocab_size_per_layer_input 262144 (per-layer embeddings); 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it set hidden_size_per_layer_input 0 (pinned configs).

All pinned Gemma 4 configs set rope_parameters.full_attention to rope_type 'proportional', rope_theta 1000000.0 and partial_rotary_factor 0.25, and rope_parameters.sliding_attention to rope_type 'default', rope_theta 10000.0; the technical report calls the global variant p-RoPE with p=0.25.

sources.quote: We encode position with p-RoPE with p=0.25 on global attention layers and with RoPE on local attention layers

text: The five pinned instruction-tuned Gemma 4 configs set text_config.hidden_activation gelu_pytorch_tanh, rms_norm_eps 1e-06 and final_logit_softcapping 30.0 (the two assistants set final_logit_softcapping null).
text_config.max_position_embeddings is 131072 for gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it and 262144 for 12B-it, 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it (pinned configs).
Every pinned Gemma 4 config (five -it models and two assistants) has text_config.vocab_size 262144 and tie_word_embeddings true.

gemma-4-26B-A4B-it's config sets text_config.enable_moe_block true, num_experts 128, top_k_experts 8, moe_intermediate_size 704 and intermediate_size 2112; no other pinned Gemma 4 model enables the MoE block.

text: Among the pinned Gemma 4 configs only gemma-4-E2B-it sets text_config.use_double_wide_mlp true.

vision_config in gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it has 16 layers, hidden_size 768, 12 heads, head_dim 64, patch_size 16 and pooling_kernel_size 3; in 26B-A4B-it and 31B-it 27 layers, hidden_size 1152, 16 heads, head_dim 72; the report gives 150M and 550M parameters for these encoders.

text: gemma-4-12B-it has no vision encoder layers in its config (vision_config model_type gemma4_unified_vision with model_patch_size 48, mm_embed_dim 3840, num_soft_tokens 280) and an audio_config of model_type gemma4_unified_audio with hidden_size 640 and audio_samples_per_token 640; the report says 12B takes 48x48x3 RGB patches and raw 40 ms audio chunks at 16 kHz as 640-dimensional vectors.

text: gemma-4-E2B-it and E4B-it configs have an audio_config of model_type gemma4_audio with 12 layers, hidden_size 1024 and 8 heads; the report describes a 305M audio encoder of two downsampling convolutions and twelve Conformer layers working on 40 ms chunks.

sources.quote: E2B and E4B Gemma models use a 305M audio encoder that processes audio in 40ms chunks with Mel filterbank inputs.

text: The Gemma 4 technical report (arXiv 2607.02770v1, section 2) describes a decoder-only Transformer with pre-norm and post-norm RMSNorm and QK-norm, 4-to-1 local-to-global attention for E2B and 5-to-1 for the other models, and p-RoPE (p=0.25, frequency 1M) on global layers with RoPE (10k) on local layers.

sources.quote: that is, 4-to-1 local attention blocks for E2B and 5-to-1 for the rest.
Our models have pre-norm and post-norm with RMSNorm

text: gemma-4-12B-it's processor_config.json uses Gemma4UnifiedProcessor with a Gemma4UnifiedAudioFeatureExtractor (feature_size 640, audio_samples_per_token 640) instead of the mel-filterbank Gemma4AudioFeatureExtractor of E2B-it and E4B-it.

The pinned assistant configs (gemma-4-12B-it-assistant, gemma-4-31B-it-assistant) have 4 layers (layer_types sliding, sliding, sliding, full_attention), hidden_size 1024, intermediate_size 8192, num_kv_shared_layers 4, head_dim 256 / global_head_dim 512, sliding_window 1024, heads 16/8/1 and 32/16/4 (query/local KV/global KV), and backbone_hidden_size 3840 and 5376, equal to the hidden_size of gemma-4-12B-it and 31B-it.

gemma-4-31B-it-assistant's generation_config.json sets is_assistant true, num_assistant_tokens 6 and num_assistant_tokens_schedule 'constant' (eos_token_id [1, 106, 50]); gemma-4-12B-it-assistant's has none of the assistant fields and eos_token_id 1.

The model cards of google/gemma-4-12B-it-assistant and 31B-it-assistant describe them as Multi-Token Prediction drafters used in speculative decoding; Google's MTP page lists a '-assistant' drafter for each of E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B and 31B.

sources.publisher: Google DeepMind (model card on Hugging Face)
sources.quote: the draft model predicts several tokens ahead, which the target model then verifies in parallel.
the lightweight 4-layer MTP drafter that proposes candidate tokens

text: The Gemma 4 technical report (arXiv 2607.02770v1, section 2.6) describes the MTP drafter as a 4-layer Transformer block (three local, one global layer) fed with the main model's last-layer activations and token embeddings that cross-attends to the main model's KVs, with model dimension 256 for E2B/E4B and 1024 for 26B-A4B/31B, and says the E2B/E4B drafters replace the full-vocabulary projection with a top-k over token clusters (d x 4096 instead of d x 262,000).

sources.quote: a 4-layer Transformer block that cross-attends to the KVs of the main model
final matrix multiplication is reduced from d\times 262,000 to d\times 4096 while preserving a similar acceptance rate.

text: Estimated INT8 KV cache of the trained models (one byte per element, scales ignored; local layers bounded by sliding_window, global layers storing K and V unless attention_k_eq_v, shared layers storing nothing): E2B 15.7 / 103.8 / 405.8 MB, E4B 44.0 / 278.9 / 1,084.2 MB, 12B 184.5 / 302.0 / 704.6 MB, 26B-A4B 125.8 / 272.6 / 775.9 MB and 31B 503.3 / 1,090.5 / 3,103.8 MB at 4,096 / 32,768 / 131,072 tokens (MB = 10^6 bytes).
formula: bytes(L) = n_local*(2*kv_heads*256)*min(L,window) + n_global*(k_or_kv*global_kv_heads*512)*L over the layers that own KV; global_kv_heads = num_global_key_value_heads or num_key_value_heads; k_or_kv = 1 if attention_k_eq_v else 2. E4B: 20*1024*min(L,512) + 4*2048*L; E2B: 12*512*min(L,512) + 3*1024*L; 12B: 40*4096*min(L,1024) + 8*512*L; 26B: 25*4096*min(L,1024) + 5*1024*L; 31B: 50*8192*min(L,1024) + 10*2048*L

text: Past the sliding window, each extra token adds an estimated 3,072 bytes of INT8 KV cache in E2B, 8,192 in E4B, 4,096 in 12B, 5,120 in 26B-A4B and 20,480 in 31B (trained-model arithmetic from the pinned configs).

The Gemma 4 technical report's Table 3 lists INT8 KV cache at 32k context as +0.05 (E2B), +0.14 (E4B), +0.28 (12B), +0.28 (26B-A4B) and +1.10 (31B); config arithmetic gives 0.104, 0.279, 0.302, 0.273 and 1.091 GB, so the report's E2B and E4B figures are half the arithmetic.

text: The Gemma 4 templates render a tool as '<|tool>declaration:NAME{description:<|"|>...<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{...},required:[...],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|>' with property types upper-cased and strings delimited by <|"|>.

The Gemma 4 E2B/E4B file template renders a tool call as '<|tool_call>call:NAME{key:value,...}<tool_call|>' with keys sorted (dictsort) and unquoted and string values in <|"|>, and inserts a string 'arguments' verbatim between the braces; Google's Hugging Face template raises an exception for string arguments.

text: The Gemma 4 E2B/E4B file template renders each tool response as '<|tool_response>response:NAME{key:value,...}<tool_response|>' with keys sorted, or 'response:NAME{value:...}' when the response is not an object, one block after another.
LiteRT-LM's Swift Conversation answers tool calls with a message {role: 'tool', content: [{type: 'tool_response', name, response}, ...]}, both in agello-next and in the shipped wrapper 85b1a776.

Rendering LiteRT-LM's tool message shape ({role: tool, content: [{type: tool_response, name: get_weather, response: {...}}]}) with google/gemma-4-E4B-it's chat_template.jinja (ee0ef602) yields '<|tool_response>response:get_weather{value:<|"|><|"|>}<tool_response|>': the response object is dropped because the template keeps only text parts of a tool message.

text: LiteRT-LM's Gemma 4 processor splits the rendered prompt at <|image|>, <start_of_image>, <|audio|> and <start_of_audio>, and replaces each image placeholder with the preceding text plus '<|image>', the preprocessed image and an image-end input (audio likewise with '<|audio>'), so placeholder tokens 258880/258881 are never fed to the model.

In agello-next with the default channel filter, a Gemma 4 reply that contains a thought and a tool call is rewound and refilled without the thought before the tool response is sent, and the E2B/E4B file template never renders the thought back, so the thought is not kept within the tool-calling turn as Google's guidance asks.

text: Agello (commit 93122b6) creates conversations without a chatTemplate override, passes ThinkingConfig(enableThinking: true, thinkingTokenBudget:) when thinking is on, and declares CurrentDateTimeTool and CalculatorTool (plus WebSearchTool when options.webSearchTool) when tools are enabled.

When Agello recreates a conversation it passes saved history as initialMessages built from plain text with roles user and model only, so tool calls and tool responses of earlier turns are not replayed in Gemma 4 tool syntax.
